assets.name: Customer Database
assets.description: Primary datastore containing customer PII and transaction metadata.

assets.name: AWS IAM Credentials & Encryption Keys
assets.description: The cloud infrastructure team manages IAM roles, policies, KMS keys, and secure access to AWS resources.

risks.title: Unauthorized access to customer data
risks.description: Weak MFA enforcement and inconsistent access reviews increase risk of account compromise and data exposure.

risks.title: Misconfigured databases or cloud storage
risks.description: A misconfigured cloud database can expose financial data to unauthorized access, impacting confidentiality and leading to financial, regulatory, and reputational damage

risks.title: data loss of sensitive company data
Vulnerable software Dependencies like outdated software
risks.description: Outdated or unsafe third-party software packages introduce known security holes into the final application.

risks.title: Over-Permissive Access Policies (Instead of Least Privelege)
risks.description: Giving an IAM user or role administrator rights instead of least-privilege access means a single compromised key exposes the entire cloud account

controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for privileged access
controls.description: Require MFA for all privileged accounts and remote access. Enforce conditional access with device compliance.

controls.name: Data Encryption (Preventive) Full disk encryption
controls.description: Full disk encryption (e.g., BitLocker, FileVault) etc or AES algorithm. Can test using static code analysis or network sniffing

controls.name: Continuous Monitoring & Alerts (Detective)
controls.description:
Use tools like CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management)
Alerts for public exposure or risky configurations

controls.name: Automated Dependency Scanning
controls.description: Using automated tools to scan dependencies

controls.name: Role-Based Access Control
controls.description: Assign permissions based on clear job roles rather than individual user accounts to prevent privilege creep.

treatments.plan: Implement RBAC and least-privilege access, enforce MFA for all users, conduct periodic access reviews, encrypt customer data at rest and in transit, and monitor access through centralized audit logging and security monitoring.
treatments.description: Implement RBAC and least-privilege access, enforce MFA for all users, conduct periodic access reviews, encrypt customer data at rest and in transit, and monitor access through centralized audit logging and security monitoring.

treatments.plan: Establish secure configuration baselines for AWS databases and cloud storage, implement least-privilege IAM policies, enable encryption, restrict public access, conduct periodic configuration reviews, and continuously monitor cloud resources for unauthorized or insecure configuration changes.
treatments.description: Establish secure configuration baselines for AWS databases and cloud storage, implement least-privilege IAM policies, enable encryption, restrict public access, conduct periodic configuration reviews, and continuously monitor cloud resources for unauthorized or insecure configuration changes.

treatments.plan: Implement regular automated backups for sensitive company data, encrypt backup copies, maintain geographically or logically separate backup locations, periodically test data restoration, and establish disaster recovery and business continuity procedures to ensure timely recovery from data loss incidents.
treatments.description: Implement regular automated backups for sensitive company data, encrypt backup copies, maintain geographically or logically separate backup locations, periodically test data restoration, and establish disaster recovery and business continuity procedures to ensure timely recovery from data loss incidents.

treatments.plan: Implement a vulnerability and patch management process to regularly scan software and third-party dependencies, identify known vulnerabilities, prioritize critical issues, and apply security patches within defined timelines. Maintain an up-to-date software inventory and ensure changes are tested and approved before deployment.
treatments.description: Implement a vulnerability and patch management process to regularly scan software and third-party dependencies, identify known vulnerabilities, prioritize critical issues, and apply security patches within defined timelines. Maintain an up-to-date software inventory and ensure changes are tested and approved before deployment.

treatments.plan: Implement least-privilege access and role-based access controls, regularly review IAM policies and user permissions, remove unnecessary access rights, enforce MFA for privileged accounts, and implement segregation of duties for critical activities.
treatments.description: Implement least-privilege access and role-based access controls, regularly review IAM policies and user permissions, remove unnecessary access rights, enforce MFA for privileged accounts, and implement segregation of duties for critical activities.
